summary: TradeOS v1.0 Alpha full audit. Backend audit (9/9 passed) via new pytest suite. Frontend audit covered: auth (login/logout/protected route), Command Center, Production Library, Opportunities (list + detail workspace + new modal), Projects (list + new modal), Invoices (list + New Invoice modal), Expenses (list + Add Expense modal), Documents, Settings (profile/subscription), full sidebar nav. All create modals open and render forms correctly. Sidebar nav is 100% clean (no dead links). CRITICAL: found 3 dead links in Command Center Quick Add panel that either show error states or eject the user from the app.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 responses observed in the browser on first paint after login (empty exception message in server logs: 'Error fetching user organizations: '). Direct pytest calls return 200 every time. Likely a race condition where the Supabase JWT is not yet valid/present in a subrequest, or is_platform_admin() httpx call transiently fails. Non-blocking (UI renders, just noisy console).
Occasional 401 on first paint after login (same race condition as above). Pytest with fresh Supabase token returns 200.

ui_bugs.component: CommandCenterPage - Quick Add panel (+ New button in header)
ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: All three Quick Add items navigate to non-existent 'new' routes: (1) 'New Opportunity' -> /app/opportunities/new -> renders OpportunityWorkspaceV2 with id='new', which calls GET /api/opportunities/new, fails, and shows 'Failed to load opportunity' error page. (2) 'New Project' -> /app/projects/new -> renders ProjectDetailPage with id='new', fails, shows 'Error: Failed to load project'. (3) 'Quick Note' -> /app/notes/new -> route does not exist, catch-all Navigate to '/' EJECTS THE USER from the authenticated app back to the marketing landing page. Fix: Quick Add items should either open the existing Create modals (OpportunitiesPage and ProjectsPage already have working New Opportunity/New Project modals) or route to /app/opportunities?new=1 style URLs. Quick Note should show 'Coming Soon' or be removed.

HIGH: Frontend calls GET /api/documents?folder= (returns 404) - backend uses /api/storage prefix. Documents page silently shows 'No documents found' empty state. Upload button opens a browser alert() saying 'Upload functionality requires Supabase Storage bucket to be configured' (placeholder). Either wire to /api/storage or ship as a proper 'Coming Soon' page.

toast.info('Assemblies coming soon...') fires from an in-app button while Assemblies view shows a full 'Coming Soon' state. Per audit spec ('Coming Soon toasts should be avoided'), replace with disabled button or wire to the existing Coming Soon empty-state.
Contains 4 toast.info('...coming soon') placeholders (Assembly, Scope Item, Labour Rate, Template creation). If this page is still reachable, these violate the audit rule.

integration_issues.issue: Recurring from iteration 17/18: '[useOrganization] Error: Failed to fetch organizations' console error on initial /app/* paint. Backend returns 500 with empty exception message. Direct API calls succeed. Retry logic (useOrganization already refetches) masks it, so UI works, but console is noisy.

issues: '+ New' button in header has no visual disabled/loading state; on click it opens Quick Add panel which then leads to error pages (see Quick Add bug above).

action_items: HIGH: Fix Command Center Quick Add panel. Options: (a) change items[].href to trigger the existing Create modals on the target pages (e.g. navigate to /app/opportunities?new=1 and read query param to auto-open modal), (b) or convert each item to an onClick that opens a shared Create modal component. Quick Note should either be removed or show a Coming Soon empty state (never eject user to /).

HIGH: Fix Documents page - either implement /api/documents (list/read/delete) backed by the storage router, or replace DocumentsPage with a proper Coming Soon component and remove the browser alert() upload placeholder.
MEDIUM: Remove or rewire the 'Assemblies coming soon' toast in ProductionLibraryWorkspace.handleCreateAssembly (line ~1852) - the view already shows a proper Coming Soon empty state.

MEDIUM: Investigate transient 500 on /api/organizations/me and /api/invoices during first paint. The empty exception logs suggest an httpx timeout or the Supabase call throwing a swallowed error. Wrap is_platform_admin call with tighter timeout+retry, and log repr(e) so future debugging is possible.
LOW: Clean up legacy ProductionLibraryPage.jsx toasts (Assembly/Scope Item/Labour Rate/Template 'coming soon') if the route /app/production-library/import is still exposed.
LOW (recurring): Hide count badges for Coming Soon nav items (Assemblies) - reported in iteration_18, not addressed.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js catch-all route Navigate to='/' silently ejects any authenticated user who lands on a bad in-app URL. Recommend a 404-not-found component inside AppLayout so users stay in the app.

OpportunityWorkspaceV2 and ProjectDetailPage should special-case id === 'new' to render a Create form instead of fetching. This is the actual pattern that would make /app/opportunities/new and /app/projects/new work as the Quick Add panel intends.
routes/organizations.py:283 does `logger.error(f'Error fetching user organizations: {e}')` — {e} is empty for httpx exceptions. Use `logger.exception(...)` or `repr(e)` to capture the actual failure.
DocumentsPage.jsx uploads use `alert()` in 2026. Replace with proper toast + modal or ship as Coming Soon.
ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx now 2157 lines (was 2156 last iteration) - still needs splitting per iteration_18 recommendation.

Frontend has two separate 'production library' pages: ProductionLibraryPage.jsx (1122 lines, legacy, still contains 'coming soon' toasts) and ProductionLibraryWorkspace.jsx (new). Legacy page routed at /app/production-library/import; verify if still needed.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest passed) - all list endpoints powering the audited pages return 200 with expected shape.
success_rate.frontend: ~85% - authentication, sidebar nav, all create modals (Invoice/Opportunity/Project/Expense), opportunity workspace, list pages all work. Deducted for: Command Center Quick Add all-3-links broken (HIGH), Documents page endpoint mismatch (HIGH), 'Assemblies coming soon' toast (MEDIUM).

rca of the issue: Command Center Quick Add dead links RCA: CommandCenterPage.jsx defines items = [{href:'/app/opportunities/new'}, {href:'/app/projects/new'}, {href:'/app/notes/new'}] and calls onNavigate(item.href). App.js only defines routes for /app/opportunities/:id and /app/projects/:id (which then fetch by id, so id='new' returns 404 from the backend and the pages show error states) and has NO /app/notes route at all, so /app/notes/new falls through to the catch-all <Route path='*' element={<Navigate to='/' replace />}/> and redirects the user to the landing page. Reproduction: log in, click '+ New' in Command Center header, click any of the 3 items -> observe (a) Failed to load opportunity, (b) Error: Failed to load project, or (c) redirected to https://.../ landing page. Mitigation: either (1) intercept id='new' in OpportunityWorkspaceV2/ProjectDetailPage and render a Create form, or (2) change Quick Add items to onClick handlers that open the existing Create modals on the target pages (Opportunities/Projects already have working modals; Quick Note has no backing feature so should show Coming Soon).
